name: Blue Hills Country Club
title: Blue Hills Caddie
sub: NCCGA, Tue Oct 27 2026 · Driver 275/300 · 2-wood 265/280 · 4-wood 255/270 at 70°F · club and aim re-solved for the wind and temperature at each hole

climate.source: late-October normals for Kansas City, MO (lows ~42 F, highs ~63 F, prevailing S wind ~10 mph); used only if the forecast file is missing

foot: Tee sets: Black (back, 7,347, 75.8/134), Blue (second-to-back, 7,025, 74.2/133) and Blue/White (6,781, 73.2/131: the Blue box on 1-3, 7, 10, 11, 14, 17, the White box elsewhere) are each fully solved from their own boxes; the other sets (White 6,567, White/Gold 6,275, Gold 6,063, Gold/Red 5,730, Red 5,312) move the Black tee along the line. Card: golfify / AllSquare (GolfPass agrees except Black hole 1). Calm-day picks: 128 prior draws per hole, 512 on the close calls. Start time and starting hole are adjustable (default 9:00 shotgun on hole 1).

hole_notes.5: the pond runs from ~50 to ~165 yds out from the Black tee (~150 from Blue): the carry to the front of the green is ~165 (Black) / ~153 (Blue).
hole_notes.6: tee shot over the pond (~110 yds to carry from Black); houses and OB along the left the whole way.
hole_notes.17: a creek crosses the fairway ~338-360 yds from the Black tee, ~300-325 from the Blue and Blue/White box; the landing area is ~40 ft below the tee, so long drives run toward it. Vegetation beyond the creek.
hole_notes.18: the creek in front of the Black tee (20-60 yds) is only a carry for a topped shot; houses and OB left.
hole_notes.1: houses and OB left beyond the trees; fairway bunkers right at 265-305 from Black.
hole_notes.2: houses and OB left; fairway bunker left at 270-285 from Black.
hole_notes.11: young trees right of the fairway at ~300-340 from Black (not in the 2006 lidar, added by hand).
